-- 各仓库当前库存、近90天出库量(锚定数据最大时间)与库存周转天数
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_time FROM inventory_movements
),
outbound AS (
  SELECT im.warehouse_id, SUM(im.quantity) AS out_qty
  FROM inventory_movements im, anchor a
  WHERE im.movement_type = 2
    AND im.moved_at >= a.max_time - INTERVAL '90 days'
    AND im.moved_at <= a.max_time
  GROUP BY im.warehouse_id
)
SELECT i.warehouse_id,
       SUM(i.quantity) AS current_quantity,
       COALESCE(o.out_qty, 0) AS outbound_90d,
       ROUND(90.0 * SUM(i.quantity) / NULLIF(o.out_qty, 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM inventory i
LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
GROUP BY i.warehouse_id, o.out_qty
ORDER BY i.warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;
